text: Seductive Power is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can only be found on Azerite Armor from the Battle of Dazar'alor.
__NOTOC__ Security Officer Durk is a hobgoblin located in Island Expeditions.
Seed-Keeper Ungan is a furbolg located in the Verdant Wilds in Island Expeditions.
Seeker's Rage is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Seeker's Scroll is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Seismic Reverberation is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Seismic Reverberation.
Seeds of Rampant Growth is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Seeds of Rampant Growth.
Seeing Blue is an exploration achievement earned by flying from the top of the Azure Archives to the Cobalt Assembly without landing.

__NOTOC__ Segallia is a dracthyr located in the Caldera of the Menders in the Forbidden Reach, tending to a Soar Enhancer. She later appears at the Bluefeather Cliffs in Thaldraszus, where she tried to introduce herself to the Screechflight harpies and was nearly eaten by them. She was rescued by Harleen Chirpsnide's mechanical chickens and has since decided to help Professor Chirpsnide with her work. Harleen gave her :Feather-Plucker 3300‎ to obtain feathers from a nearby cave, but she was ambushed by the harpies, and the plucker broke. She sent an adventurer to collect its pieces, and she then repaired the plucker. After recovering feathers for a disguise, she accompanied Harleen and the a
Seer Shinetotem is a Highmountain tauren priest seen speaking with Leila Startotem in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.
Seething Essences drop from bosses in the Emerald Nightmare during The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power, if the quest has already been completed on another character.
:"Are there demons nearby?"- Illidan Sense Demons was an ability used by Warlocks. When activated, you will see every enemy's demon in the minimap as a red dot (), friendly demon as a green dot ().

Sentinel Hill is an Alliance settlement located in eastern Westfall. It has a flight path (gryphon roost), barracks-like inn, mailbox, forge, anvil, multiple cottages, and lumber mill down the hill from Sentinel Tower.
Senior Sergeant T'kelah was a jungle troll quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
Senior Sergeant Grimsford was a Forsaken quest giver located in the Trade Quarter in Undercity.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Amarassan was an elite rare mob night elf found in southern Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. She could be found patrolling the route between the ruins at the center of Stonetalon Peak and the entrance to Talon Den. She was friendly towards Alliance players.

__NOTOC__ Selendra is a dryad located on Sar'theris Strand just south of Shadowprey Village in Desolace, along with several of Marandis' Sisters. She and Keeper Marandis are originally from the Stonetalon Mountains, but came to Desolace on a quest to kill Princess Theradras so they could retrieve Zaetar's body from Maraudon and bring it back to Stonetalon.
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Amberline is a night elf bowyer located at Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight. She appears to be a serious individual based on her annoyance with Sentinel Sweetspring.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Stillbough is a night elf located in lower level of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Before the Cataclysm, she had some rather unpleasant conversations with Archmage Mordent Evenshade. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Heliana is a night elf found near Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains. She is keeping watch on Horde activity in the mine.
__NOTOC__ Selor is a night elf flight master found in Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.

The Sentinel Tree is a magical tree with roots in Azeroth but a canopy in the Molten Front's daily quests section of the Firelands, where it provides much needed protection to the Guardians of Hyjal as they mount their counterattack to the Firelands Invasion.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel-trainee Issara was a night elf quest giver found just inside Blackfathom Deeps of Ashenvale alongside with Sentinel Aluwyn, Relwyn Shadestar, and Ashelan Northwood. Since Warlords of Draenor, she is no longer found in the updated dungeon, her whereabouts remain unknown.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Aluwyn is an elite night elf quest giver found just inside Blackfathom Deeps of Ashenvale alongside with Ashelan Northwood. Before Warlords of Draenor, she was accompanied there with Sentinel-trainee Issara, and Relwyn Shadestar.
Sentinel Cordressa Briarbow is a night elf quest giver located inside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, not far from Tyrande Whisperwind.
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Strikers are night elf guards located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. They also appear in Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit during To Mogujia (Alliance).
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Mistress Geleneth is a night elf quest giver located at the Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains. She is investigating the strange happenings at Stonetalon Peak.
Sentry Dverga is a dwarf located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Self-Forging Credentials drop from Patrol Captain Gerdo in Court of Stars.
Sen'jin Spirit Drummers are jungle trolls. They briefly appeared during the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin, playing drums.
Sentry Dangard is an orc located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Sentry Frazblink is a goblin located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Moonshade is a night elf located in Suramar.

Selya Glade is a human child living in a cottage in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. She is the daughter of Robb and Ceya. When Greydon Thorne returned to his former wife Ceya and asked for his son Aram to join him, Selya cried along with her mother.
This beacon will command the Sentinax on the Broken Shore to blast the area, briefly turning the user into felslate, and leaving several lootable Felslate Spikes behind.
Sentinel Ambushers are night elves located in the Stonetalon Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Falia was a night elf located in Nazmir. She was attacked by the Horde champions at Fort Victory in Nazmir. She was apparently slain along with Sentinel Aeolyn and Sentinel Lyrias by Blood Prince Dreven, although her death was later avenged by Shandris Feathermoon when she slew Dreven.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Aeolyn is a night elf located in Nazmir. She was apparently slain along with Sentinel Falia and Sentinel Lyrias by Blood Prince Dreven, although her death was later avenged by Shandris Feathermoon when she slew Dreven.
Sentry Fish Schools can be found in the waters around Mechagon Island.
Sentry Fish are fished from Sentry Fish Schools in the waters around Mechagon Island. The fish can also be looted from Old Rusty Chests in the Western Spray.
Sentinel's Moonglaive drops from mobs in Darkshore or is contained in Sentinel Equipment Cache.
Sentry Enforcers are Mechagon mechagnomes located on Mechagon Island.
Sentry Ambushers are Mechagon mechagnomes located on Mechagon Island.
Sentry Heel Nuts drop from Upgraded Sentries and are contained in Scrap Piles on Mechagon Island.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Lyrias was a night elf located in Fort Victory and Redfield's Watch in Nazmir. She was slain along with Sentinel Aeolyn and Sentinel Falia by Blood Prince Dreven, although her death was later avenged by Shandris Feathermoon when she slew Dreven.
__NOTOC__ Senior Producer Gixi is a goblin located in Island Expeditions.

Senthii, As Gul'dan is a exploration achievement that doesn't appear to be available. Instead, there's a single achievement for participating in all of the performances at the Star Lake Amphitheater: Ardenweald's a Stage.
Self-Embalming Kit is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sentinel's Leafbough Chestpiece is a quest reward from Denying Manpower.
Sentinels of the New Moon are night elves located in the Ancient Bough in the Ohn'ahran Plains and in the Ancient Bough in the Emerald Dream.

.]] Serpents or cobras are a type of large snakes that come in a variety of colors. The cobras of Azeroth are renowned for their fast-acting venom and swift strikes. They are good swimmers and attack with their fangs and Corrosive Spit. Serpents are found in the Wailing Caverns, Zul'Gurub, Silverpine Forest, Zul'Farrak, Sholazar Basin, the Sunken Temple, and in Shadowmoon Valley. Sseratus was the loa serpent god until he was killed by the Drakkari.
Serpentskin Spaulders are a continent drop from Eastern Kingdoms mobs.

__NOTOC__ Sergeant Shatterskull is one of Nazgrel's most trusted warriors stationed at the Supply Caravan just outside of Thrallmar in the Hellfire Peninsula. He directs Horde adventurers to combat the Burning Legion in the Felspark Ravine.

Serpentshrine Tidecallers are water elementals found in Serpentshrine Cavern. *78 495 HP (125 592 pre-2.1) *Immune to frost damage and effects *Despawns when the Greyheart Tidecaller's Water Elemental Totem is destroyed.
Serenity Dust is one of the pet abilities that only moths can use.
Serban Oprescu is a crewman of the Assurance found in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City.
Serrah's Star is an trinket. It gives a bonus to critical strike rating.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Moonshard is a night elf quest giver located in Zul'Drak.

__NOTOC__ Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl is a Frostwolf orc found in Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley. Yazra and Teeka were briefly seen together in Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley when Eitrigg arrived to see Drek'Thar. Later, they were present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Serpent Spread is a passive specialization ability for Survival hunters, available at level 68.

__NOTOC__ Sergeant Bahrum is a dwarf and the leader of Bahrum's Post in Dun Morogh. He sends Alliance adventurers to free Frozen Mountaineers, directs them to attack Dark Iron Spies (not knowing that they are allied with the Twilight's Hammer cult), and to deliver the Dark Iron Attack Plans to Commander Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airport.
Sergeant Houser is a Forsaken sergeant found in the War Quarter of the Undercity. He is surveying the training of Alyssa Blaye, Eldin Partridge and Travist Bosk.
Sergeant Houser is a Forsaken sergeant found in the War Quarter of the Undercity.

Sergeant Dontrag is an orc quest giver first met at the Horde outpost of Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale, listening to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain give a speech. He later takes a caravan to join the war effort in Stonetalon Mountains, and due to his high rank is sent onwards to Krom'gar Fortress. He is then put in charge of getting supplies from the Deep Reaches, but his team is waylaid by problems. During the Fourth War, he led an assault against Stardust Spire. He was encountered by Alliance champions.
The Serpent Ward is summoned by Shadow Hunter's Serpent Ward spell and is immune to magic.
__NOTOC__ Serenka is a draenei located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. She also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Serpent Warriors are pandaren found in the Terrace of the Twin Dragons in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. They are trying to fight the Lesser Sha and the Minions of Doubt. After the minions are destroyed, they get corrupted by doubt and run away.
Serr'ah is a jungle troll quest giver and vendor located in the Frostwall's Menagerie. She revives dead pets. She is also found in Magical Menagerie in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ Sentry Pierce is a human located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain. He informed Emmarel Shadewarden of Khadgar's arrival to the lodge.
Sentry Sumner is a worgen located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Sentry Sprydash is a night elf located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Sentry Wendade is a human located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Sentry Seamster is a human located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Serpent Master Xisho is a mogu encountered during Island Expeditions.

]] Serpents of N'Zoth are huge, flying, worm-like aberrations associated with the Old God N'Zoth. The black serpents of N'Zoth are the harbingers of the Old God's ultimate vision becoming reality. Despite the name, these creatures are not unique to Azeroth: several massive serpents were among the Void forces that invaded the Shadowlands realm of Bastion in the past. The Curious Slime Serpent is a similar-looking but probably unrelated creature found in Maldraxxus.

Septic Shock is a conduit for rogues. It drops from the following bosses: *Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae).
Sentry Worgs are worgs located in Jotunheim in Icecrown. They are often found accompanying Jotunheim Warriors. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.

The Sepulcher of Knowledge is a library tower located at the northern end of a fungal valley in north-northwest Maldraxxus. It contains records of mortal souls who have arrived in Maldraxxus, histories of great battles, weapons, and combatants, and—most valuably—the military writings of the greatest tactical minds to have ever served among the necrolords. The oldest tomes are reserved for the eyes of the Primus alone. The tower used to be guarded by liches, but in the present day none can be found here. After the Primus' disappearance, the Sepulcher was magically sealed. The Primus placed five guardians in the area around the facility, each connected to a runestone and embodying the virtues
Serpentstalker's Trickery is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Serpentstalker's Trickery.

Seraphic Wristwraps are sold by Erunak Stonespeaker in Kelp'thar Forest and Iris Moondreamer in Mount Hyjal for .
Sephuz's Proclamation is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Sephuz.

The Serene Dreams Spa is located north of Valdrakken in Thaldraszus. The area is split up in different sections, with the lower being overrun by elementals, and the upper grounds being safe. There's also a floating island containing the VIP section.
Serpent Idols are located in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain. Interacting them will provide Posion Immunity for two minutes.
The Serpent Queen is a serpent that would have been found in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain.

__NOTOC__ Servants of Grol are tauren, orc, Forsaken, and jungle troll followers of Grol the Destroyer found in the Blasted Lands. They cannot be killed by normal means, to do so you'll have to damage them down to about 5% of their health and click the crystal nearby (this can only be done during The Stones That Bind Us).
__NOTOC__ Sethekk Guard are arakkoa found in the Sethekk Halls. They give 10 Lower City reputation when killed on Normal Mode and 15 on Heroic Mode.
__NOTOC__ Sethekk Initiates are arakkoa found in the Sethekk Halls. They are often followed by Avian Darkhawks. They give 9 Lower City reputation when killed on Normal Mode and 15 on Heroic Mode.
__NOTOC__ Sethekk Oracles are arakkoa found in the Sethekk Halls. They gives 9 Lower City reputation when killed on Normal Mode and 15 on Heroic Mode.
__NOTOC__ Sethekk Prophet are found in Sethekk Halls. They are vulnerable to all forms of Crowd Control. They give 9 Lower City reputation when killed on Normal Mode and 15 on Heroic Mode.
Sethekk Shaman are arakkoa found in Sethekk Halls. They give 9 Lower City reputation when killed.
The Servants of Ilgalar were darkhounds found in and around the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains.

The Servants of Azora are gnomes located in the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. They serve their master Archmage Theocritus and the unknown entity Azora. They can be found throughout the tower and the immediate area outside. A Captured Servant of Azora can be found in Redridge Mountains.

The Severed Arm was lost in an unfortunate accident and needs to be sewn back on its owner. Fishers capable of fishing in Northrend waters are randomly offered the fishing daily quest Disarmed! from Marcia Chase in Dalaran. In Patch 3.3.3, Monsterbelly Appetite has transitioned to Disarmed! and only requires a trek of 50 yards to the waters outside Violet Hold instead of the southern end of the continent.
This item is crafted with Inscription, via the Darkmoon Card of the North recipe.

Cook 5,000 Cataclysm cooking recipes. Note that not all Cataclysm recipes count towards this achievement. When first added to the game, only recipes that created level 85 food gave credit for this achievement. Over time, a series of hotfixes have changed it so that in general, all Cataclysm recipes count unless all of their ingredients are purchasable from vendors. In addition their were a small number of non-Cataclysm recipes that erroneously gave credit until they were also hotfixed. Recipes that no longer count for this achievement (this list may be incomplete): * Chocolate Cookie * Darkbrew Lager * Feathered Lure * Highland Spirits * Kungaloosh * Conjured Mana Biscuit * South Island Iced
Servants of Siamat are elite air elementals that appear during the fight with Siamat in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.

The sethrak are a race of serpent people living in Vol'dun on Zandalar. The sethrak are an empire on the rise and throwing a wrench in everyone's plans. Wherever the sethrak go sand begins to spread as they magically change the environment into what they are comfortable with.

The Servants of Illidan are a group of humanoids, dragonkin and demons who serve Illidan Stormrage. They are underlings of the Illidari and do what they can to destroy the Burning Legion. They are composed of the Ashtongue tribe of Broken, the Coilskar tribe of naga and a group of shivarra that formerly served the Burning Legion, as well as of fel orcs and satyrs.

Sethrak Wardens are sethrak located at the Sethrak Front in Nazmir as well as at the Abandoned Burrows, the Blistering Wastes, and the dunes near the southwestern mountains in Vol'dun where they force Vulpera Slaves to mine :Azerite.

Sethrak Warbringers are sethrak located at the Sethrak Front in Nazmir as well as at the Abandoned Burrows, the Blistering Wastes, and the dunes near the southwestern mountains in Vol'dun. They are normally mounted on krolusks but dismount when attacked.
Sethrak Ravagers are sethrak located at the Sethrak Front in Nazmir as well as at the Abandoned Burrows, the Blistering Wastes, and the dunes near the southwestern mountains in Vol'dun.
Severed Head of Putress was Putress' head that Varian Wrynn tossed at Thrall's feet in the aftermath of the Battle for the Undercity.
Sethrak Raiders are sethrak located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun prior to the Alliance's takeover of the port. They can only be seen by Alliance players that have yet to complete Ooh Rah!.
Sethrak Menders are sethrak located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun prior to the Alliance's takeover of the port. They can only be seen by Alliance players that have yet to complete Ooh Rah!.

Sethrak Battle Riders are sethrak that ride Krolusk Warcrawlers around Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun prior to the Alliance's takeover of the port. They can only be seen by Alliance players that have yet to complete Ooh Rah!.
Seven of Putrescence is a reagent for Darkmoon Deck: Putrescence.
Seven of the Indomitable is a reagent for the Darkmoon Deck: Indomitable.
Shadi Mistrunner is a tauren trade goods vendor located on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.
Shadewood Cloak is a cloak that gives a bonus to strength, stamina, and nature resistance.
Shadefiend Boots are a set of leather boots that give bonuses to strength, agility, and stamina. They can be useful to druids (particularly feral ones) and rogues.
__NOTOC__ Sewer Beast is a rare mob albino crocolisk found in Stormwind City's Canals.

Shade of Aran is a boss in the abandoned tower of Karazhan. He is the spirit of Nielas Aran, the father of Medivh — the previous occupant of Karazhan. He is located in the Guardian's Library, which is a small, circular room (about 45 yards in diameter) with one door that closes and locks as soon as the fight begins. Shade of Aran is an optional boss. However, after he is defeated, a teleport to his room becomes available from , and all trash mobs from The Curator to Aran (exc. one pack outside Illhoof's door) cease to respawn.
The Sha'tar Tabard is worn by the Sha'tar faction in Shattrath City. It is also given to their most trusted allies.

__NOTOC__ Sha'nir is a draenei quest giver who runs the Shattrath Infirmary in Shattrath's Lower City. She is a trained Aldor healer, but is not considered a member of the Aldor in-game faction and is friendly to both Aldor and Scryers. According to the children at the orphanage, Sha'nir has told them that they can come help her when they are older.
Shaarubo is a Broken meat and drink vendor located in World's End Tavern in Shattrath City.

Shade of the Horseman will attack Kharanos, Goldshire, Azure Watch, Razor Hill,Brill, and Falconwing Square. These attacks consist primarily of Shade of the Horseman circling overhead on a flying horse. As he circles the village, he throws flaming pumpkins at the various buildings, and at points, at players. The Shade of the Horseman is spawned by a player starting the daily quest "Let the Fires Come!". This quest is only available during Hallow's End. Should the shade already be active, players can also take part by instead picking up Stop the Fires!. Only one of the "Fires" quests can be completed each day.

Shaani is a draenei jewelcrafting vendor located on the first floor of the Inn of the Sun's Reach Harbor on the Isle of Quel'Danas. She spawns once players have retaken the Harbor. Once players create the Alchemy Lab as part of the Shattered Sun Offensive storyline, she will sell her wares.

:This article is about Arugal's appearance in Grizzly Hills. For the character's biography, see Archmage Arugal. For the character's appearance in the Shadowfang Keep instance, see Archmage Arugal (tactics). The Shade of Arugal is an undead located at Shadowfang Tower on Bloodmoon Isle off the coast of the Grizzly Hills.
Shade of Ambermoon is a night elf ghost found in Southwind Village in Silithus. She leads the tortured spirits of fallen druids and Sentinels.

The Shade of the Kaldorei is a shade of a night elf that appears to tell the tales of night elven history to adventurers at the moonwells of Teldrassil. The shade appears at the following quests: *Teldrassil: Crown of Azeroth *Teldrassil: Passing Awareness *Teldrassil: The Refusal of the Aspects *Teldrassil: The Burden of the Kaldorei *Teldrassil: The Coming Dawn

Shade of the Hexxer is the spirit of Jin'do the Hexxer, who appears to be attempting to revive the forces of Zul'Gurub following their defeat. During the quest Be Raptor the player controls Ohgan'aka and attempts to escape from Zul'Gurub, only to be confronted by Jin'do near the exit. Like any good villain, Jin'do explains his plans in great detail before allowing the hero to escape; it is revealed that he is trying to summon Hakkar and needs Ohgan'aka for this task. He threatens to destroy you but instead evicts you from Ohgan'aka's body and challenges you to come back at a later time. During the quest Backdoor Dealings, players observe a conversation between Jin'do and Zanzil the Outcast.
__NOTOC__ Seyala Nightwisp is a night elf hippogryph flight master located in Shadebough in Feralas.

The sha (known as ikk to the hozen) are physical manifestations of negative emotions — such as doubt, despair, fear, hatred, or anger — found in Pandaria. These malevolent spirits were spawned from the essence of the Old God Y'Shaarj after it was slain by the titan Aman'Thul and its remains fell back on the land that would later be called Pandaria. For thousands of years, the sha lay relatively dormant below Pandaria, but the arrival of the Alliance, the Horde and their war on Pandaria's shores caused the sha to once again rise up to threaten the land. However, since the Heart of Y'Shaarj was drained of its last remaining power during the Siege of Orgrimmar, the sha will eventually cease to

Shado-Pan Garrison is the crossroads of Rensai's Watchpost, Sik'vess, and Niuzao Temple in southwest Townlong Steppes. The Underbough and Kri'vess are to the northeast. Most of the major Shado-Pan players in Townlong wind up at the garrison, including Rushi the Fox, the Shado-Pan quartermaster. Upon completing the quest Through the Portal, players will be able to teleport between Shado-Pan Garrison and Shan'ze Dao.

.]] Shademaster Kiryn is a Forsaken rogue and quest giver that takes part in multiple Horde quests throughout Jade Forest and later reappearing in Kun-Lai Summit and Krasarang Wilds. She is a skinning trainer, and at times acts as an innkeeper, with food and drink for sale. She also has knowledge about anatomy and poisons, which she uses on her throwing stars.
Sha-Touched Footmen are humans found in the Shrine of Seven Stars.

Sha of Pride is the seventh of the prime Sha after Doubt, Despair, Fear, Anger, Hatred, and Violence. It is the core of the corruption of the Vale itself, spawned when Garrosh's arrogance unleashed the powers of the Heart of Y'Shaarj. It made its lair within an old titan chamber where the Heart was discovered. The Sha of Pride is the fourth boss of the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance, making him the final boss of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms segment which precedes the actual siege.
Sha Puddles are oozelings found at the Pools of Power of Siege of Orgrimmar.
The Sha'tari Skymesa is an area above in Talador that can only be accessed using the elevator in the Shattrath City Center below.
The Sewer is a subzone of Shattered Halls. It is the highly disgusting and highly conspicuous backdoor to the Throne of the Damned.
Shadetalon is a raven located at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind City.
Sewer Sludges are sludge beasts located in the Undercity during A Personal Request. Others were encountered by the Black Harvest champions in Dalaran's Underbelly.

Sevriss is a large elite serpent that roams the dunes north of Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. The Goldtusk Inn's "Giant Deadly Unstoppable Killer Cobra Experience" activity challenges participants to travel into the dunes and try not to be killed by Sevriss.
Sha Cloud is a sha cloud located at the Ruined Passage of Siege of Orgrimmar. Using the cloud teleports the player to the corridor, the entrance to get to the Fallen Protectors from Immerseus.
Sha-Touched Grunts are orcs located in the Shrine of Two Moons.
Shadefruit is located in Suramar City during The Old Fashioned Way.
Shado-Pan Mercenary Kits are sold for by Brewer Ahna and Brewer Goshi during Island Expeditions.
Shad'har the Insatiable is a void hound located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Sha'tari Calvary are draenei located in the Shattrath Commons and Shattrath City Center in Talador. They are riding elekks.
Severus the Outcast is a human located in Beryl Meadow in Stormsong Valley. He uses blood magic and is devouring the corpses of Harald the Scarred, Ranald Flamehair, and Herme the Wise.
The Shadebound Testimonial drops from mobs in the Maw with higher chance from more powerful enemies.
Shadeweb Huntress is a tarantula located in Island Expeditions.
Shade Essence-Lure is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shackle Keys is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shadesinger's Bargain is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Shadehound Tooth is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Shadeleaf Runestag is a runestag flying mount sold by Elwyn in the Heart of the Forest for after reaching 23 Renown (Shadowlands) with the Night Fae Covenant.
Shadestar Mace was a quest reward from Researching the Corruption.

Shadow Orbs are a unique Shadow priest resource displayed in the user interface beneath the player's health and mana bars. They become available to Shadow priests at level 21. Shadow Orbs are generated by Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death. They are used to cast Devouring Plague and Psychic Horror. Priests can have a maximum of 3 Shadow Orbs at a time, or 5 once Enhanced Shadow Orbs has been acquired. Psychic Horror will consume up to 3 Shadow Orbs, empowering the spell according to the number consumed, requiring a minimum of 1 Shadow Orb; while Devouring Plague always consumes 3 Shadow Orbs, and cannot be cast with fewer. The Shadowlands intro experience comprises the first three storylines of the Shadowlands campaign. Sylvanas Windrunner has shattered the Helm of Domination and torn a hole in the veil between the mortal plane and the realm of death above the Frozen Throne upon Icecrown Citadel. Several faction leaders have been kidnapped for Sylvanas' unknown purpose. It's up to the champion and the Ebon Blade to venture through the veil and save reality!
